fixture_statement: All three zones and project contexts are synthetic test fixtures, not real locations.

soil.source_or_derivation_note: Broad pilot substrate class; requires a zone soil observation, test or intersected soil evidence.

moisture.source_or_derivation_note: Broad pilot moisture class; not a measurement and requires seasonal site confirmation.

hydrology.source_or_derivation_note: Broad pilot hydroperiod class; no depth, duration or groundwater measurement is claimed.

light.source_or_derivation_note: Broad pilot exposure class; requires user observation or a geometry/time-specific study.

canopy.source_or_derivation_note: Context only. It explains light and is deliberately not scored a second time.

disturbance.source_or_derivation_note: Broad demonstration disturbance class; traffic proximity alone is not a measured stress response.

hardscape.source_or_derivation_note: Demonstration adjacency flag; requires mapped zone geometry and feature intersection.

waterEdge.source_or_derivation_note: Demonstration edge flag used by the marginal-plant gate; absence is not inferred from map silence.

source.source_or_derivation_note: The authoritative scorer value is demo because all matching inputs in this fixture are synthetic.

path_edge.source_or_derivation_note: Demonstration placement context; requires mapped path geometry before real use.

available_width_m.source_or_derivation_note: Plausible clear-width fixture, not a measurement of the named location.

available_length_m.source_or_derivation_note: Plausible clear-length fixture, not a measurement of the named location.

plantable_area_m2.source_or_derivation_note: Plausible usable-area fixture, not parcel or city area.

max_plant_height_m.source_or_derivation_note: Demonstration visibility envelope; a project decision, not a mapped fact.

support_length_m.source_or_derivation_note: Demonstration usable support length; requires mapped support geometry.

type.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture project type; never inferred from maps.

maintenance.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture maintenance capacity; must be supplied by the project team.

character.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture spatial character; a design preference, not site evidence.

vigourControl.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture containment commitment; not inferred from maintenance capacity.

evaluation_stage.source_or_derivation_note: The fixture runs placement-stage hard gates.

publicAccess.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture policy; never inferred from public-space mapping.

publicHarvest.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture policy; never inferred from project type.

sightlines.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture policy; mapped path geometry is still needed for real use.

rewilding.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture native-only policy; never inferred from ecology or maps.

support.source_or_derivation_note: Explicit test-fixture support availability; requires user confirmation and mapped support for real use.

area.source_or_derivation_note: Demonstration project-area envelope; not a cadastral or surveyed area.

anchorColours.source_or_derivation_note: Optional demonstration design preference; never overrides a gate.

desiredFlowerMonths.source_or_derivation_note: Optional demonstration design preference; never supplies suitability points.

priorities.source_or_derivation_note: Optional demonstration output preference; never overrides a gate.

confidence.formula: weighted mean of location/project field confidence, kept separate from compatibility

Every matching value requires user confirmation, intersecting map evidence, or survey evidence before real use.
Complete operational values make the pilot scoreable; they do not make the evidence high-confidence.
